Minimum work cost of the above mentioned work shall be amounting Tk. 35 (Thirty-five) Lac.
The above mentioned work could have been completed under a single number of contracts under Govt./ Semi-Govt./Autonomous
bodies.
Certificate of authentication in respect of the work should have to be fumished by the tenderer along with tender documents in the
following manner as applicable :
i. In case of the work done under any PWD, the Certifying and authenticating authority shall be the concemed Executive
Engineer under whom the works has been Executed.
ii. In case of the work done under any Govt./Semi-Govt./Autonomous bodies than PWD the certifying authority shall be
an officer of that organization not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
